items.title: Apple Brown Spot
items.summary: Apple Brown Spot: symptom recognition, epidemiology, and management essentials.
items.content:
[Symptoms]
Apple Brown Spot may cause leaf spots, fruit lesions, mold, or rot depending on humidity and crop stage.

[Epidemiology]
Pathogens often overwinter in infected plant debris or soil and spread by rain, wind, tools, or insects. Warm, humid conditions and poor ventilation increase severity.

[Management]
• Sanitation: remove infected leaves, fruit, and branches.
• Cultural: improve spacing and airflow; balanced fertilization; resistant varieties when available.
• Chemical: apply registered protectants before infection and curative products at early onset; rotate modes of action and observe pre-harvest intervals.

items.title: 梨蚜虫
items.summary: 梨蚜虫: damage symptoms, identification, and control options.
items.content:
[Damage]
This pest feeds on tender shoots, leaves, or fruit, causing curling, discoloration, honeydew, or direct fruit damage.

[Identification]
Inspect new growth and undersides of leaves; confirm with local extension guidance when possible.

[Management]
• Monitoring and traps where applicable.
• Conserve natural enemies.
• Use targeted pesticides at susceptible stages; rotate active ingredients.
